description:
## Problem
The owner asked for a checkpoint after the first milestone because TPC-DI is an obsolete TPC workload and the remaining work is large.

## Owner decisions (choice dialogs, 2026-11-20)
- "After the first milestone (DuckDB: historical load passes the audit at the smallest scale) stop and report cost and remaining work before the incremental batches and other platforms."
- Cloud: "No approval now. They stay refused for TPC-DI; I bring a cost estimate per platform at the milestone stop and you decide then."
- "Its deletion pull request is prepared but lands only after you have seen the milestone report."

## Change
Write the report: cost so far (pull requests, heavy-run wall time, generation time and disk); the list of audit tests excluded at the milestone with reasons, for approval; the DIGen comparison; feasibility probes for the next platforms (the appendix SQL translated and run on DataFusion and ClickHouse Local; a three-row type-2 expire-and-insert probe on each); a cost estimate per cloud platform for one scale 3 run; the remaining steps with sizes; the PDGF use-clause question for DIGen-sourced publication. Ask the owner through the choice dialog: continue, change scope, or stop; approval of the excluded-test list; cloud approval per platform.

## Decision gates
This item changes no code. Nothing after it starts until the owner answers. The owner's answers are recorded verbatim here and on the plan item.

## Verification rubric
Pass: the report is delivered; the owner's answers on continuation, the excluded-test list and each cloud platform are recorded verbatim on this item; later items are updated or dropped to match.

## Guardrails (owner, 2026-11-20)
- The agent never posts a stand-in review, closes and reopens a pull request to restart CI, uses `--no-verify`, force-pushes, rewrites an author, or deletes anything under `~/Developer/benchmark_runs`.
- Arming: `make pr-arm` once; one more attempt only when the refusal named a cause, the agent reported it and the cause is cleared; never a third without asking. `make pr-rerun` at most once and only for a job the runner never ran or cancelled, never for a failed test.
- Review threads: reply; resolve only after the bot's review of the new head does not raise the finding again.
- Subagents are read-only. No file edit by script; use the edit tool. Do not edit a pull request description while its CI is starting; post a comment.
- Any limit, default, threshold, status token, message or label text the owner has not already chosen (see tpcdi-correction-plan-20261120) is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- A blocked step stops this item; no workaround. No live cloud run. Heavy work only through `make heavy-run`. One pull request for this item, merged before the next item starts.
- From the quarantine step until the reopening step, no TPC-DI entry point may produce a result that reads PASSED or is admitted for publication.
